1.title: Conquest of Khaybar
1.description: Capitulation of the Jewish fortresses of Khaybar after several weeks of siege, securing the northern frontier of Medina.

10.title: Martyrdom of Al-Hussein ibn Ali at Karbala
10.description: Martyrdom of the grandson of the Prophet ﷺ and of his family, facing the Umayyad army under the reign of Yazid ibn Mu'awiyah at Karbala.

4.title: Fall of Baghdad to the Mongols
4.description: Capture and sack of the Abbasid capital by Hulagu Khan, the murder of the last Abbasid caliph of Baghdad (Al-Musta'sim) and the end of the Abbasid Caliphate of Iraq.

9.title: Battle of An-Nahrawan
9.description: Clash between the army of the caliph Ali ibn Abi Talib and the Kharijite group that had broken ranks after the arbitration of Siffin.

1.title: Battle of Siffin
1.description: Battle on the banks of the Euphrate between the partisans of the caliph Ali ibn Abi Talib and the governor of Syria Mu'awiyah ibn Abi Sufyan, leading to the episode of arbitration (at-Tahkîm).

2.title: Fall of Granada
2.description: Surrender of the last Nasrid emir Boabdil to the Catholic Monarchs, marking the disappearance of the last Muslim kingdom of Spain.

12.title: Death of the Prophet ﷺ
12.description: Death of the Prophet ﷺ in Medina on a Monday, followed by the designation of Abu Bakr as-Siddiq as the first caliph and the end of the Quranic revelation.

24.title: Battle of Hattin
24.description: Resounding victory of the army of Salah ad-Din al-Ayyubi (Saladin) against the Crusader troops, the immediate prelude to the recovery of Jerusalem.

20.title: Conquest of Constantinople
20.description: Conquest of the Byzantine imperial capital by the Ottoman sultan Mehmed II (Al-Fatih), marking the end of the Byzantine Empire.

30.title: Battle of the Three Kings
30.description: Decisive victory of the Saadian Moroccan army under Ahmad al-Mansur against the Portuguese army of king Sebastian I in northern Morocco.

11.title: Battle of the Great Zab
11.description: Defeat of the last Umayyad caliph of Damascus, Marwan II, against the Abbasids, marking the fall of the Umayyad dynasty in the East and the rise of the Abbasid Caliphate.

22.title: Death of the caliph Abu Bakr as-Siddiq
22.description: Death of the first caliph of Islam after he consolidated the state during the wars of apostasy (Hurûb ar-Riddah) and designated Umar ibn al-Khattab as his successor.

5.title: Battle of Al-Yarmouk
5.description: Decisive strategic victory of the Muslims over the Byzantine Empire in the Yarmouk valley, marking the end of Byzantine domination in Syria and Palestine.

12.title: Battle of Al-Zallaqah
12.description: Victory of the Almoravid emir Yusuf ibn Tashfin over Alfonso VI of Castile, delaying the Christian Reconquista in Al-Andalus by several centuries.

27.title: Peaceful entry into Jerusalem
27.description: Arrival of the caliph Umar ibn al-Khattab in Jerusalem to receive the surrender of the city and grant peace to its inhabitants, signing the pact of protection of cults (Al-'Uhda al-'Umariyyah).

27.title: Liberation of Jerusalem by Saladin
27.description: Solemn entry of Salah ad-Din al-Ayyubi into the holy city of Jerusalem, on the anniversary day of Al-Isra' wal-Mi'raj.

27.title: Formal abolition of the Ottoman Caliphate
27.description: Decision of the Grand National Assembly of Turkey deposing the caliph Abdülmecid II and officially ending more than thirteen centuries of the caliphal institution in the Muslim world.

9.title: Battle of Alarcos
9.description: Resounding victory of the Almohad caliph Abu Yaqub Yusuf al-Mansur over the Castilian army of Alfonso VIII in Andalusia.

27.title: Battle of Poitiers / Path of the Martyrs
27.description: Clash in Gaul between the Muslim army led by Abd ar-Rahman al-Ghafiqi (who was martyred there) and the Frankish troops of Charles Martel.

17.title: Battle of Badr
17.description: The first major military victory of the Muslims over the Quraysh, a founding event in the history of the Muslim community.

17.title: Assassination of the caliph Ali ibn Abi Talib
17.description: Blow struck in Kufa by the Kharijite Abd ar-Rahman ibn Muljam, sealing the end of the period of the Rightly Guided Caliphs (al-Khilafah ar-Rachidah).

20.title: Conquest of Mecca
20.description: Triumphant and peaceful entry of the Prophet ﷺ into Mecca and purification of the Ka'aba from the idols.

25.title: Battle of Ayn Jalut
25.description: Decisive victory of the Mamluk army of Qutuz and Baybars halting the devastating Mongol invasion in the Near East.

28.title: Battle of Guadalete
28.description: Victory of the Muslim troops led by Tariq ibn Ziyad over the Visigothic army of king Roderic, opening the Iberian peninsula to Islam (Al-Andalus).

6.title: Battle of Hunayn
6.description: Clash against the tribes of Hawazin and Thaqif, occurring immediately after the conquest of Mecca and illustrating the trial of overconfidence in numbers.

7.title: Battle of Uhud
7.description: Confrontation near mount Uhud marked by the trial of the archers and the martyrdom of Hamza ibn Abd al-Muttalib (other chronicles give the 15th of Shawwal).

21.title: Battle of Mohács
21.description: Resounding victory of the Ottoman sultan Suleiman the Magnificent over the kingdom of Hungary, extending Ottoman influence into Central Europe.

27.title: Battle of Manzikert
27.description: Victory of the Seljuk sultan Alp Arslan over the Byzantine emperor Romanos IV Diogenes, opening Anatolia to the settlement of Muslim Turks.

9.title: Day of Arafat of the Farewell Pilgrimage
9.description: Proclamation of the great farewell sermon by the Prophet ﷺ and revelation of the verse on the completion of the religion, during his only pilgrimage after the Hijra.

18.title: Martyrdom of the caliph Uthman ibn Affan
18.description: Assassination of the third caliph at his home while he was reading the Quran, marking the outbreak of the first great discord (Al-Fitnah al-Kubra).

26.title: Martyrdom of the caliph Umar ibn al-Khattab
26.description: Stabbed at dawn in the mosque of Medina by Abu Lu'lu'a al-Majusi, he succumbed on the 1st of Muharram 24 AH after establishing a consultative council (Shura) for the election of his successor.
